referenceName: Landscaping portfolio with seasonal planning wheel

source.name: Spicer Designs Landscaping website template
source.rightsEvidence: The downloaded HTML package contains a CC BY 4.0 license and its source page permits commercial use with attribution. The package README identifies the sole raster asset as AI-generated placeholder art; the remaining project visuals are inline SVG/CSS. Asset and font provenance is recorded locally.

provenance.capture: Full-page desktop and mobile screenshots captured from the local, unmodified plain-HTML distribution at 1440x1000 and 390x844. The static HTML package presents click-driven widgets in their initial state.
provenance.attribution: Spicer Designs, CC BY 4.0. The original Spicer Designs footer credit remains visible in both captures.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A warm, botanical landscaping experience that promotes portfolio work before a service inventory. A quiet utility navigation and editorial serif hero sit over a low-contrast AI-generated garden image with a grid of illustrated landscape vignettes. Nine example projects lead into a four-season planning wheel, an explicit maintenance-plan comparison, a lot-size estimate builder, a constrained route coverage list, project-category proof, and an editorial FAQ close. Screenshot imagery and all sample facts are reference-only.

heroGeometry.alignment: large left-aligned editorial headline against a soft full-width landscape image and asymmetric grid of illustrated garden scenes
heroGeometry.viewport: brand, primary promise, one-sentence scope and estimate action are visible in the opening desktop viewport

navigationGeometry.mode: quiet wordmark with direct section anchors
navigationGeometry.placement: compact top bar above the image-led hero
navigationGeometry.mobile: wordmark and call route remain first; anchor links wrap or compact without covering the opening

typography.display: expressive editorial serif with italic botanical accent
typography.scale: large fluid hero headline, restrained uppercase section labels, compact but readable project metadata

palette.contrastIntent: calm natural contrast with dark green actions and sufficiently dark body text

imageTreatment.mode: soft AI-generated landscape atmosphere paired with hand-drawn inline-SVG project mosaics
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero image with a text-safe wash; project diagrams use consistent landscape cards
imageTreatment.focalPoint: quiet landscape color and planting geometry, never an identifiable client property or person

servicePresentation.pattern: portfolio first, then seasonal job selector, then a maintenance comparison matrix
servicePresentation.interaction: project-category filters and a season selector inform the visitor before a lot-size and selected-service estimate

ctaPlacement.primary: estimate request in the opening and beside the estimator
ctaPlacement.early: before service details, immediately after the promise

motion.primitive: category filtering, season selection, and progressive estimate updates
motion.library: plain HTML/CSS and browser events in the source family; downloaded static HTML captures initial states only
motion.reducedMotion: keep the entire project set, season text, pricing rows and estimate explanation visible without transitions

mobileRecomposition.strategy: stacked editorial portfolio and practical service flow
rules: keep hero promise and estimate action before the project tiles
collapse the mosaic into a readable single-column project rhythm
wrap or scroll filter controls without page-level horizontal overflow
convert the plan matrix into labeled mobile rows
keep the estimate total visible beside or directly below its form

prohibitedPatterns: copying Stonefield Landscape or Spicer brand assets, names, copy, or wording
reusing demo prices, addresses, coverage, reviews, estimates, warranties, or schedule claims
presenting AI-generated hero art as a photograph of a client property
claiming staff or customers from stock or demo imagery
inventing seasonal dates, per-visit costs, service routes, or plant guarantees
adding an unsupported live availability or route tracker

requiredSignatureElements.description: project imagery or an approved landscape visual leads the page rather than a service-card grid
seasonal work selector whose copy and timing come from verified business inputs
plan comparison with a shared feature column and explicit inclusions
bounded estimate tool using verified service rates and visitor-supplied property size
clear coverage list derived from verified service areas, not inferred offices

acceptanceChecks: desktop opening keeps the promise and estimate action in the first viewport
the project portfolio precedes service-plan detail
season selector and price estimator expose a static no-JavaScript fallback
all prices, route facts, guarantees and quotes come from sealed verified content
mobile capture has no horizontal page overflow and the plan comparison remains legible
the original attribution appears in both screenshot footers
the AI-generated hero art is never claimed to depict a real customer property

review.scope: CC BY 4.0 package, bundled asset provenance, local full-page paired captures, and transferable design mechanics
